note: An API group of Zid's own, Merchant APIs > Products > Product Badge (ZD-I-0011, an inventory entry Q1 placed in ZD-C-083, which no statement covers). It is a place of its own (an API group, by the dry run's convention), so it is a capability; no statement says what a badge is or where it shows, so the capability rests on the name only, and a reviewer may fold it into CM-CAT-001. Zid only so far.

capability: Barcode printing (Zid Barcode Printing / طباعة الباركود)
note: A plan line of Zid's Product & Inventory Management group (ZD-I-0249, placed in ZD-C-083, which no statement covers). A place of its own (a plan line); no statement says what is printed or from where, so it rests on the name. Shopify's barcode permission (products:variants:update:barcodes, in CM-CAT-002) is about a variant's barcode value, not printing; the back-fill decides whether it is cited here. Zid only so far.

capability: Inventory withdrawal priority (Zid Inventory Withdrawal Priority / أولوية السحب من المخزون)
note: A plan line with its own description, 'Set inventory withdrawal priority to avoid stockouts and ensure quick order fulfillment.' (ZD-S-0919), and a help-center statement that it isn't in the free plans (ZD-S-1023). No statement says what the priority is set among; that it orders the stock locations an order draws from is a reading, not stated, so its parent is inventory tracking (CM-INV-001), not locations (CM-INV-005). Zid only so far.

capability: Products shown by the customer's city (Zid Display Products by Customer City / عرض المنتجات حسب مدينة العميل)
note: A plan line of Zid's Product & Inventory Management group (ZD-I-0257) that Q1 placed in Zid's inventory concern ZD-C-085, and a plan card that groups it with inventory counting and transfer, 'Inventory counting, transfer, and display by customer city' (ZD-I-0405). No statement says what decides which products a city sees; that it follows the stock at locations is a reading. A reviewer may move it to domain E (storefront) if a statement shows it is a display setting. Zid only so far.
